requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4435-4550-5567-8249--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4435-4550-5567-8249--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

4694-4828-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
4694-4828-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
4694-4828-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat

1479-2841-6529-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-6529-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2841-6517-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-6517-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3899-5276-6767.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Rescue Skiff from exile to the battlefield.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

664-5166--86.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Frilled Deathspitter to take damage.
664-5166--86.description:
Cause Frilled Deathspitter to take damage by any method.
Frilled Deathspitter triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Frilled Deathspitter.
Repeat from step 2.

413-6854--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
413-6854--5--195.description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Host of the Hereafter trigger.
Resolve Host of the Hereafter's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

654-2893-3875-7906.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Amulet of Vigor.
When the basic land enters, Amulet of Vigor, Tireless Provisioner and Thranduil's Company trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}
Repeat.

requires.n: Instant or Sorcery that Targets a Creature and Creates Treasure
Creature that Returns an Instant or Sorcery from Graveyard to Hand on Entering

5134-7845--178--179.description:
Cast Fated Infatuation by paying its mana cost targeting the creature that can recur spells.
When you cast that spell, Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Fated Infatuation and choosing Spinerock Tyrant as its target.
Resolve the copy of Fated Infatuation, creating a Spinerock Tyrant token.
Resolve the original Fated Infatuation, creating a token copy of the spell recursion creature.
When that token enters, it triggers, returning Fated Infatuation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time, resulting in a total of five Spinerock Tyrants.
Cast the spell that creates a Treasure token by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature.
Each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying that spell once for each Spinerock Tyrant you control.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating at least one Treasure token each time.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding one mana per Treasure.
Cast Fated Infatuation by paying its mana cost targeting the spell recursion creature.
When you cast that spell, each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Fated Infatuation once for each Spinerock Tyrant and choosing the spell recursion creature once and Spinerock Tyrant as each additional spell's target.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating two copies of the spell recursion creature and additional copies of Spinerock Tyrant.
When the first spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning the spell that creates Treasure from your graveyard to your hand.
 When the second spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning Fated Infatuation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 7.
5134-7845--178--179.notes: The mana needed is calculated assuming you use a spell that costs 2 to cast and creates one Treasure token.

671-2173-4496-5220.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, sacrificing itself.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2049-3259-6633.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2049-3259-6633.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

215-3291-3464.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least five.
215-3291-3464.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Sword of the Paruns

5149-5200-7221.notablePrerequisites: There's an Elf card in your graveyard.
5149-5200-7221.description:
Activate Lys Alana Dignitary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Lys Alana Dignitary
Repeat.
5149-5200-7221.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5223-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2231-4871-5220-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2231-4871-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

997-4336-5220-6900.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

647-6188-6911.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent. There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-6188-6911.description:
Declare Fear of Missing Out as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Fear of Missing Out, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that isn't legendary.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters, it triggers, causing you to rummage
During your next combat phase, declare Fear of Missing Out and the Fear of Missing Out token as attackers.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, causing you to untap the nontoken Fear of Missing Out and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-2448-5220-5708.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-5220-5708.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

803-2921-4338.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Arcane Adaptation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2613-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
2613-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
2613-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to  Spiteful Sliver.
Spiteful Sliver triggers, dealing 100 damage to target player.

222-413-527-4927.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-4927.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

4120-4565-4968.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4120-4565-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
4120-4565-4968.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

2781-5256-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Felidar Guardian.
2781-5256-6132.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1537-2532-4617-4906.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
1537-2532-4617-4906.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin abilities, adding eight {R} and giving creatures you control trample until end of turn.
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Jaxis' ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Jaxis abilities, creating a token that's a copy of each other creature you control with haste.
Put the token Agrus Kos into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Agrus Kos and Zealous Conscripts tokens trigger.
Resolve the Agrus Kos trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zealous Conscripts trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat, using the Soulbright Flamekin token instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the legendary creature.

1367-3039-4450-5361.notablePrerequisites: Auton Soldier is a copy of Carth the Lion.
1367-3039-4450-5361.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Activate Liliana Vess's second loyalty ability by removing zero loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Nexus of Fate, then shuffling your library and putting it on top.
Move to your next turn, drawing Nexus of Fate during your draw step.
Repeat.

1849-2563-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control with an egg counter on it.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
1849-2563-3259.description:
Declare Xira and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Xira triggers, putting an egg counter on any other creature you control.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Xira.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any other creature you control with an egg counter on it, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Xira triggers, causing you to draw a card and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

46-2634.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Cooperate from your graveyard by paying {2}{U}, targeting the spell.
Activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Cooperate, with the copy targeting the original Cooperate.
Resolve the copy of Cooperate, copying Cooperate, targeting the original Cooperate.
Repeat step 4.

2713-4385-4474-5153.notablePrerequisites:
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
2713-4385-4474-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {1}.
Pay {1} to create a 1/1 Sliver token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
